issues.description: Missing explicit #include <stdlib.h> for free() call. The free() function is called on line 49 (free(out)) but <stdlib.h> is not explicitly included. In practice this compiles because yyjson.h includes <stdlib.h> internally, but explicit inclusion is recommended for code clarity and portability.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add #include <stdlib.h> after the existing includes for explicit free() declaration.

issues.description: Unused import: 'import os' is imported but only referenced in a commented-out line (line 31: '# self.run(f"{os.path.join(...)}"...). The os module is not used in any active code path.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove 'import os' since it is not used in active code, or uncomment the alternative test approach and remove the cmake.test() if the direct binary execution approach is preferred.

issues.description: The checkbox '安全弹窗触发确认' (security popup trigger confirmation) is marked as passed [x] in Phase 3, but this check appears inapplicable for a pure C JSON library with no GUI or system-level interaction. This is likely a template artifact that was auto-checked without verifying applicability.
issues.fix_suggestion: Verify whether this checkbox applies to yyjson. If not applicable, remove it from the notes or mark it as N/A.

issues.description: Docstring format slightly deviates from convention. Code-style rule 1 specifies format 'Conan recipe — {name} {version} ({build_system})'. The current docstring says 'Conan recipe for yyjson 0.12.0 — High-performance JSON library in ANSI C.' which mentions the language (ANSI C) but does not explicitly annotate the build system as (CMake).
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider updating docstring to: """Conan recipe — yyjson 0.12.0 (CMake)""" or """Conan recipe for yyjson 0.12.0 (CMake) — High-performance JSON library in ANSI C."""
